resources.string: Hide the launcher icon only. Open with *#*#888#*#* on a supported system dialer. Installation records and processes remain visible.

This hides only the launcher icon, not the installed package, files or processes.

First test *#*#888#*#* in your system dialer while the icon is still visible. A supported dialer opens the app without placing a call. Do not press Call if nothing happens.

Keep the recovery commands from CHUNIAN_README.md. The dialer code is a shortcut, not a password. You can restore the icon by turning this switch off.
I have tested the dialer entry and saved the recovery commands.
